about_the_game:
KeySorter - The Keyboard-First File Organizer

Tired of endless clicking and dragging? Organize thousands of files with simple keyboard shortcuts. KeySorter is the revolutionary utility that lets you sort images, videos, code, and everything else at the speed of thought. Stop managing files and start creating.

About This Software

Drowning in a sea of files? Your Downloads folder, project assets, and countless screenshots have finally met their match. Say goodbye to hundreds of mouse drags. Welcome to a new workflow where a single keystroke does the work of a hundred clicks.

KeySorter is a revolutionary, keyboard-centric file organizer built for developers, designers, content creators, and every power user in between. We've combined the familiar feel of a file explorer with powerful customization to supercharge your productivity.

✨ Key Features

  • ⚡ Lightning-Fast Sorting Instantly move or copy files to up to 36 custom categories using keys 0-9 and A-Z. Tidy up thousands of files in minutes, not hours.

  • 🎨 Intuitive 3-Panel UI Get started instantly with a familiar 3-panel layout (Folder Tree, File List, Category Panel).

  • Easily set categories with drag and drop (Folder tree to Category)

  • 🖼️ Powerful Built-in Viewer Preview images, text, and code without leaving the app. Sort files on the fly while viewing them in thumbnail, list, or detail mode.

  • ⏳ AI generated image Sorting (beta): Imagine KeySorter automatically suggesting categories based on an image's AI prompt or filename. It's on our horizon!

  • Compressed file support (beta): Double-click to open compressed files like ZIP and TAR, view them, and sort them.

  • 🌐 Full International Support Natively supports most languages on Steam, allowing users from all over the world to feel right at home. (Core languages like English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese are fully supported).

🚀 If You Are a...

  • Developer & Programmer: Instantly organize code snippets, libraries, and logs by project or language.

  • Designer & Artist: Master your collection of inspiration, references, and assets. Sort by artist, project, or style with unparalleled speed.

  • Content Creator & Streamer: Systematically organize your raw footage, thumbnails, and sound effects to dramatically cut down on editing time.

  • Data Hoarder & Archivist: Build your personal knowledge base by cleanly archiving vast amounts of data using only your keyboard.

Development Roadmap - KeySorter is Always Evolving

We're not stopping here. Look forward to these upcoming features!

Cut your file organization time by over 90% and reclaim your focus for what truly matters. Build your ultimate file management system today. Get KeySorter now!
